verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a PostHog sandbox, test environment or isolated non-production project for safe testing. The nearby evidence does not qualify. Feature-flag percentage rollouts happen on real production users. Sharing flags across projects is an adjacent feature, not isolation. The CLI option to skip artifact upload is a dry-run style behavior, not sandbox isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
